name: Assassin's Creed II: Ultimate Edition
storyline: The lineage continues as this new chapter introduces Ezio, inheritor of the talents and creed of the Assassins. After his family is murdered by rival families, Ezio resolves to learn the ancient art of the Assassin in order to seek revenge. He does not pursue this alone, allying with historical figures such as the philosopher and writer Niccolò Machiavelli, and drawing on the weapons and instruments created for him by the renowned inventor and Renaissance genius Leonardo Da Vinci.
summary:
This version includes:

- Assassin's Creed II (base game)
- Sequence 12 - Battle of Forli (DLC)
- Sequence 13 - Bonfire of the Vanities (DLC)
